verse.verse_1: When the Event will come to pass
verse.verse_2: – and then there will be no one to deny its occurrence –
verse.verse_3: (a calamitous Event) that shall turn things upside down:
verse.verse_4: when the earth will suddenly shake with a terrible shaking,
verse.verse_6: and will scatter abroad into fine dust.
verse.verse_7: You shall then become three groups.
verse.verse_8: The People on the Right: and how fortunate will be the People on the Right!
verse.verse_9: And the People on the Left: and how miserable will be the People on the Left!
verse.verse_10: As for the Foremost, they will be the foremost!
verse.verse_11: They shall be near-stationed (to their Lord),
verse.verse_14: and a few from later times.
verse.verse_15: They (will be seated) on gold-encrusted couches,
verse.verse_16: reclining on them, arrayed face to face;
verse.verse_17: immortal youths shall go about them
verse.verse_18: with goblets and ewers and a cup filled with a drink drawn from a running spring,
verse.verse_19: a drink by which their minds will not be clouded nor will it cause drunkenness;
verse.verse_20: they will also go about them with the fruits of which they may choose,
verse.verse_21: and with the flesh of any fowl that they may desire to eat;
verse.verse_22: and there shall be wide-eyed maidens,
verse.verse_23: beautiful as pearls hidden in their shells.
verse.verse_24: All this shall be theirs as a reward for their deeds.
verse.verse_25: There they shall hear no idle talk nor any sinful speech.
verse.verse_26: All talk will be sound and upright.
verse.verse_27: As for the People on the Right, how fortunate shall be the people on the Right!
verse.verse_28: They shall be in the midst of thornless lote trees,
verse.verse_34: They shall be on upraised couches,
verse.verse_35: and their spouses We shall have brought them into being afresh,
verse.verse_36: and shall have made them virgins,
verse.verse_37: intensely loving and of matching age.
verse.verse_38: All this will be for the People on the Right;
verse.verse_39: a large throng from the ancients,
verse.verse_40: and also a large throng from those of later times.
verse.verse_41: As for the People on the Left: how miserable will be the People on the Left!
verse.verse_42: They will be in the midst of scorching wind and boiling water,
verse.verse_43: and a shade of thick, pitch-black smoke,
verse.verse_44: which will neither be cool nor soothing.
verse.verse_45: Surely they had lived before in luxury,
verse.verse_46: and had persisted in the Great Sin.
verse.verse_47: They used to say: “What! Once we are dead and are reduced to dust and bones, shall we still be raised to a new life from the dead?
verse.verse_49: Tell them, (O Prophet): “The earlier ones and the later ones
verse.verse_50: shall all be brought together on an appointed Day.
verse.verse_51: Then you, the erring ones and those that gave the lie to the Truth,
verse.verse_52: shall all eat from the Tree of al-Zaqqum,
verse.verse_54: and thereupon you shall drink boiling water,
verse.verse_55: drinking it as thirsty camels do.”
verse.verse_56: Thus shall they be entertained on the Day of Recompense.
verse.verse_57: We have created you, then why would you not confirm it?
verse.verse_58: Did you ever consider the sperm that you emit?
verse.verse_59: Do you create a child out of it, or are We its creators?
verse.verse_60: It is We Who ordained death upon you and We are not to be frustrated.
verse.verse_61: Had We so wished, nothing could have hindered Us from replacing you by others like yourselves, or transforming you into beings you know nothing about.
verse.verse_62: You are well aware of the first creation; then, do you learn no lesson from it?
verse.verse_63: Have you considered the seeds you till?
verse.verse_64: Is it you or We Who make them grow?
verse.verse_65: If We so wished, We could have reduced your harvest to rubble, and you would have been left wonder-struck to exclaim:
verse.verse_68: Did you cast a good look at the water that you drink?
verse.verse_69: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds or is it We Who brought it down?
verse.verse_70: If We had so pleased, We could have made it bitter. So why would you not give thanks?
verse.verse_71: Did you consider the fire which you kindle?
verse.verse_72: Did you make its tree grow or was it We Who made it grow?
verse.verse_73: We made it a reminder and a provision for the needy.
verse.verse_74: Glorify, then, (O Prophet), the name of your Great Lord.
verse.verse_75: No! I swear by the positions of the stars –
verse.verse_76: and this is indeed a mighty oath, if only you knew –
verse.verse_77: that this indeed is a noble Qur'an,
verse.verse_79: which none but the pure may touch;
verse.verse_80: a revelation from the Lord of the Universe.
verse.verse_81: Do you, then, take this discourse in light esteem,
verse.verse_82: and your portion in it is simply that you denounce it as false?
verse.verse_83: Why, then, when the soul leaps up to the throat,
verse.verse_84: the while you are helplessly watching that he is on the verge of death,
verse.verse_85: – at that moment when We are closer to him than you, although you do not see (Us)
verse.verse_86: if you are not subject to anyone's authority,
verse.verse_87: why are you then not able to bring them back to life if you are truthful?
verse.verse_88: So if he is one of those who are near-stationed (to Allah),
verse.verse_89: then happiness and delight and Gardens of Bliss are his.
verse.verse_90: And if he is one of the People on the Right,
verse.verse_91: he will be welcomed by the words: “Peace to you” from the People on the Right.
verse.verse_92: And if he is one of those who give the lie (to this Message) and go astray,
verse.verse_93: then he will be served boiling water,
verse.verse_94: and will be scorched by the Fire.
verse.verse_95: That indeed is the absolute truth.
verse.verse_96: So glorify the name of your Great Lord.
